primary_guardian.name: primary_guardian
primary_guardian.description: Primary Guardian Multisig (3-of-5 recommended). Root authority for treasury, timelock override, emergency pause, oracle revocation, release signoff.
primary_guardian.notes: Replace TO_FILL entries with EIP-55 checksummed 0x... addresses or ENS names (example.safe.eth). After Safe creation, replace the UUID placeholders in manifest with the Safe address.

oracle_signer.name: oracle_signer
oracle_signer.description: Oracle signer multisig (2-of-3 recommended). Controls ILunarOracle metadata updates, signer rotation, staleness threshold changes.

emergency_pause.name: emergency_pause
emergency_pause.description: Emergency pause multisig (2-of-2 recommended). Fast-acting safe for circuit breaker and Beast gateway global pause.
